patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Shopware's shape. Workflow advantage: Shopware leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote.; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shopware-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Shopware if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
